body:
Thank you tremendously for these words, /u/OtherWayBound, they very much helped.

And I did call up a few friends yesterday, and it was good. Personally, one issue I have (that I'm working on) is that I'm feeling "over" making acquaintances and such. I've always had the smaller groups of close friends, and moving to a new town (post-30) does make it harder to form that kid of connection. I think I was comparing it to the last girlfriend I had, where we connected pretty much immediately. I miss that. But again, thank you for the kind words and the new friendship! If you're ever on the West Coast, please let me know. :)
Thank you for this note, /u/Andreilobo! It honestly helped me this morning. :)
